get.summary: Liveness: the process is up. No dependency checks.
Readiness: the database is reachable and all EF Core migrations are applied.

post.summary: Create an account (the first account becomes Admin) and sign in. Rate limited per IP.

409.description: Conflict

post.summary: Sign in with email and password (sets the auth cookie and refreshes XSRF-TOKEN). Rate limited per IP.
Sign out (clears the auth cookie). Requires X-XSRF-TOKEN when signed in.

get.summary: The signed-in user with their system role.
Which sign-in providers are configured.
Issues the XSRF-TOKEN cookie; send its value as X-XSRF-TOKEN on cookie-authenticated mutations.
Redirects to GitHub to sign in (FR-2). 404 when GitHub sign-in isn't configured.
Redirects to GitHub to link it to the signed-in account (FR-2). 404 when not configured.
GitHub OAuth callback, handled by the GitHub handler: redirects to returnUrl, or to /login?error=GITHUB_AUTH_FAILED&reason=… on failure. 404 when GitHub sign-in isn't configured.
The caller's API tokens, newest first (including revoked and expired ones). Browser session only.

post.summary: Create a token. The plain token is returned once; only its SHA-256 hash is stored. Browser session only.

delete.summary: Revoke one of the caller's tokens (idempotent). Browser session only.

get.summary: Users, newest first, optionally filtered by a search over email and name.

patch.summary: Change a user's system role (browser session only). The last Admin can't be demoted (409 CONFLICT).

409.description: Conflict

get.summary: The caller's projects (every project for Admins), paged, with search by name, phase and status filters and sorting.

post.summary: Create a project from the wizard; the caller becomes its Owner. Omitted settings take the FR-5 defaults.

get.summary: A project (members and Admins; 404 for anyone else).

patch.summary: Edit name, approval mode, threshold and limits (Owner). 409 CONFLICT on a concurrent edit.

409.description: Conflict

delete.summary: Delete a project and everything it owns (Owner).

get.summary: Phase, status, version, artifact summary, execution counts, review state and pending gates (members).
The project's members (members and Admins).

post.summary: Add an existing user by email (Owner). 404 USER_NOT_FOUND for an unknown email, 409 CONFLICT if already a member.

409.description: Conflict

patch.summary: Change a member's role (Owner). The last Owner can't be demoted (409 LAST_OWNER).

409.description: Conflict

delete.summary: Remove a member (Owner), or leave the project (any member removing themselves). The last Owner can't be removed (409 LAST_OWNER).

409.description: Conflict

get.summary: Git, LLM and notification settings with secrets as set / not set flags (Owner).

patch.summary: Update the Git settings (Owner). A GitHub provider needs a https://github.com/<owner>/<repo> URL.
Update the LLM provider, models and optional project API key (Owner).
Replace the notification channels (Owner). Slack/Teams webhook URLs are secrets (sent in secret, returned masked). A channel sent with its id and no secret keeps its saved secret.

post.summary: Test the saved Git settings: repo reachable, writable, default branch exists (Owner). Never changes settings.

Advance to the next phase (Contributor or Owner). Returns the new state, or the pending gate created when the approval mode requires one (phase unchanged). 409 PHASE_PRECONDITION_FAILED (with reason), GATE_PENDING, WRONG_PHASE or CONFLICT.

409.description: PHASE_PRECONDITION_FAILED (details lists every unmet condition), GATE_PENDING, WRONG_PHASE (already in release) or CONFLICT.

get.summary: The project's gates, newest first, optionally filtered by status (members).

post.summary: Approve a pending gate (Owner). Applies the gated transition; escalation gates need a decision (continue, rollback with targetVersion, or accept). 409 GATE_NOT_PENDING, 400 INVALID_DECISION.

409.description: GATE_NOT_PENDING, PHASE_PRECONDITION_FAILED, WRONG_PHASE, ROLLBACK_BLOCKED (escalation rollback) or CONFLICT.

429.description: RATE_LIMITED: escalation rollback within a minute of the last rollback; see Retry-After.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the action is allowed again.

post.summary: Reject a pending gate (Owner). The phase is unchanged and the agent that produced the gated artifact re-runs with the comment as feedback. Escalation gates can't be rejected (400 INVALID_DECISION). 409 GATE_NOT_PENDING.

409.description: GATE_NOT_PENDING or CONFLICT.

get.summary: The project's activity feed, newest first (members). Filter by category with type; load more with before = the previous page's nextBefore. limit defaults to 50 (max 100).
The latest version of each artifact type that exists, without content (members).
The highest version of an artifact type, with content and integrity (members).

404.description: NOT_FOUND: the project, or no version of this type exists.

get.summary: Every version of an artifact type, newest first, without content (members).
One version of an artifact type, with content and integrity (members).

400.description: VALIDATION: unknown artifact type or version below 1.

get.summary: Line diff between two versions of an artifact type: unified text plus a structured line list for side-by-side rendering (members).

400.description: VALIDATION: unknown artifact type, from/to missing or below 1, or the versions have more than 100,000 lines together.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: the project, or either version.

post.summary: Save edited Markdown as a new draft version (Contributor or Owner): version = latest + 1, parent = latest; an open draft of the type becomes superseded. With baseVersion, 409 CONFLICT unless it is still the latest version. 409 WRONG_PHASE.

400.description: VALIDATION: unknown artifact type, or empty or too long content. INVALID_PLAN: a plan draft whose aide-plan block is missing, repeated or invalid, or that does not read back to the same steps once rendered (details: every reason).

409.description: WRONG_PHASE: the type can't be edited in the current phase; CONFLICT: baseVersion is no longer the latest version (details: latestVersion), or a concurrent save.

post.summary: Approve a draft (Owner): records approver and time, sets locked and applies the invalidation cascade (§4.4). Approving an already locked artifact is a no-op. 409 ARTIFACT_NOT_DRAFT.

400.description: VALIDATION. INVALID_PLAN: a plan whose aide-plan block is invalid, or whose steps declare more files than the project's current max files per step (details: every reason).

409.description: ARTIFACT_NOT_DRAFT (rejected, superseded, invalidated or corrupted, or created after the version the project was rolled back to), ARTIFACT_LOCKED or CONFLICT.

post.summary: Reject a draft (Owner): records the comment and re-runs the producing agent with it (not for human-edited drafts). 409 ARTIFACT_NOT_DRAFT, ARTIFACT_LOCKED.

409.description: ARTIFACT_NOT_DRAFT, ARTIFACT_LOCKED or CONFLICT.

get.summary: The project's agent runs, newest first, paged, optionally filtered by agent (members).
One agent run with its output (members). 404 NOT_FOUND for a run of another project.
The refinement state (members): the latest project request version, the latest round with its status, and the clarifying questions of the latest completed round with any answers already given.

post.summary: Run a refinement round (Contributor or Owner): queues the Idea Refinement agent on the idea, the current draft and the answers given (questionId of a question from the latest round, or the question text). Returns 202 with the queued round; the new draft and questions arrive with the run. 409 WRONG_PHASE, BUDGET_EXCEEDED, REFINEMENT_IN_PROGRESS.

400.description: VALIDATION: an answer is blank or too long, names an unknown questionId, has neither questionId nor question, or answers a question twice; more than 20 answers.

409.description: WRONG_PHASE (not in refinement), BUDGET_EXCEEDED (token budget used up), REFINEMENT_IN_PROGRESS (a round is queued or running) or CONFLICT (a concurrent start).

get.summary: The execution steps of a plan version, in step order (members). Without planType and planVersion this is the current plan: the most recently locked plan that owns steps (the implementation plan, or the optimisation plan of a review cycle); `plan` names its type and version. With planType only, that type's highest locked version; with planVersion, that version of planType (default implementation_plan). With no locked plan the result has no plan and no steps.

400.description: VALIDATION: unknown planType, or planVersion below 1.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: the project, or the requested plan version.

post.summary: Start execution (Contributor or Owner): prepares the working copy and project branch if needed, clears the pause flag and queues the next runnable step of the current plan (FR-31, FR-35). Returns 202 with the execution state; progress arrives over the live channel. 409 PHASE_PRECONDITION_FAILED, BUDGET_EXCEEDED, CONFLICT.

409.description: PHASE_PRECONDITION_FAILED (not in execution, no locked plan, or nothing runnable), BUDGET_EXCEEDED (token budget used up) or CONFLICT (a concurrent change).

post.summary: Pause execution (Contributor or Owner): a running step finishes, but no new step starts until resumed (FR-37). Idempotent. Returns 202 with the execution state.

409.description: PHASE_PRECONDITION_FAILED (not in execution) or CONFLICT (a concurrent change).

post.summary: Resume paused execution (Contributor or Owner): clears the pause flag and queues the next runnable step (FR-37). Returns 202 with the execution state.

409.description: PHASE_PRECONDITION_FAILED (not in execution), BUDGET_EXCEEDED (token budget used up) or CONFLICT (a concurrent change).

get.summary: The project pull request (members, FR-36): provider, base and head branch, GitHub number and URL (null for Local), and the branch comparison read from the working copy — commits (newest first, at most 250) and changed files (at most 1000). For a Local project the comparison is the "PR". 404 NOT_FOUND until AIDE has opened it (when every step of the plan is completed).

404.description: NOT_FOUND: the project, or no pull request has been opened yet.

post.summary: Open the project pull request again (Contributor or Owner, FR-36), e.g. after the pull request job failed or its retries ran out: queues the pull request job. Allowed in execution once every step of the current plan is completed, or in review, while no pull request is recorded for the current plan. In review the job only records the PR; in execution it then advances to review. Returns 202; the outcome arrives as PULL_REQUEST_OPENED or PULL_REQUEST_FAILED on the live channel.

403.description: FORBIDDEN: Viewers can't open the pull request.

409.description: PHASE_PRECONDITION_FAILED (not in execution or review, steps not all completed, or the PR for the current plan is already recorded) or CONFLICT (a pull request job is already queued or running, or a concurrent change).

post.summary: Run a review cycle now (Contributor or Owner, FR-38): queues the review job (deterministic checks plus the Code Review agent), which records a compliance report, applies the §4.5 decision and, on review_required, drafts the optimisation plan. Only in the review phase. Returns 202 with the job id and the cycle the review will record; progress arrives as REVIEW_STARTED and REVIEW_COMPLETED on the live channel.

403.description: FORBIDDEN: Viewers can't start a review.

409.description: WRONG_PHASE (the project isn't in the review phase), REVIEW_IN_PROGRESS (a review job is already queued or running) or CONFLICT (a concurrent change).

get.summary: The latest compliance report (members, FR-38, FR-41): overall score vs threshold, category breakdown with weights, agent scores, penalties and evidence, violations, missing features, drift level and areas, the §4.5 decision and its reason, and the optimisation plan it produced. Only reports of the current review timeline count: at or below the current project version and created after the last rollback (§4.8), so a rollback hides every earlier report, even once the project is back at that version.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: the project, or no review has completed yet.

get.summary: The compliance score across review cycles, oldest first, with the project's threshold (members, FR-41). The series is empty before the first review. Only reports of the current review timeline count: at or below the current project version and created after the last rollback (§4.8), so a rollback hides every earlier report, even once the project is back at that version.

The drift level and areas of the latest compliance report (members, FR-41, §4.7). Only reports of the current review timeline count: at or below the current project version and created after the last rollback (§4.8), so a rollback hides every earlier report, even once the project is back at that version.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: the project, or no review has completed yet.

post.summary: Retry a failed release (Owner, FR-43): queues the release job again for the current project version (merge the project PR or branch into the default branch, tag v<version>-aide, or the first free v<version>-aide.<k> when a version number reused after a rollback is already tagged elsewhere; an existing tag of the version holding the branch is a no-op). Only in the release phase with status releasing, after the latest attempt failed (e.g. MERGE_CONFLICT resolved on the branch). Returns 202 with the new in_progress release; the outcome arrives on the live channel.

202.description: The release job was queued; the release is in_progress.

409.description: NOT_RELEASING (not in the release phase with status releasing, e.g. already released), RELEASE_IN_PROGRESS (a release job is queued or running) or CONFLICT (a concurrent change).

get.summary: Every release attempt of the project, newest first (members, FR-42, FR-43). Empty before the first release.
The latest release attempt (members, FR-42, FR-43): in progress, succeeded, or failed with its error and conflicting files.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: the project, or no release has started yet.

post.summary: Roll the project back to an earlier version (Owner, FR-44, FR-45, §4.8). In one transaction: restores the phase recorded at that version (status rolled_back), invalidates artifacts created after it, resets their plans' steps, cancels pending gates and queued jobs, clears the review state and records the rollback. The Git branch is not rewritten. Checks run in order: INVALID_TARGET_VERSION, ROLLBACK_BLOCKED, RATE_LIMITED (one rollback per project per minute).

200.description: The rollback was applied and recorded.

400.description: VALIDATION (targetVersion < 1, reason empty or over 500 characters) or INVALID_TARGET_VERSION (not below the current version, not recorded, or a release-phase version).

409.description: ROLLBACK_BLOCKED with details ["reason: <step_in_progress|agent_run_in_progress|release_running|release_partially_applied>"] (a step, agent run or release job is running, or a queued release retry already merged), or CONFLICT (a concurrent change).

429.description: RATE_LIMITED: a rollback within the last minute; see Retry-After.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the action is allowed again.

get.summary: Every rollback of the project, newest first (members, FR-44), including rollbacks chosen on escalation gates.

The project's versions from its state transitions, newest first (members, FR-44): the phase recorded at each version (the latest transition at that version; version 1 without one is refinement), when it was entered, and whether it is a valid rollback target now.

ActivityItemDto.description:
One entry of a project's activity feed (FR-50). `type` is the stored event type (e.g. `PHASE_CHANGED`),
`category` its feed category (`null` for internal events), `summary` a one-line description and
`payload` the raw event payload.

ActivityPageDto.description: A page of the activity feed, newest first. Pass `nextBefore` as `before` to load more; `null` when there is no more.

ActorDto.description: Who did something: a user (`id` and display name) or the system actor (`isSystem`, no `id`).

AddMemberRequest.description: Adds an existing user by email (FR-8).

AdminUserDto.description: A user as shown on the admin users page.

AdvancePhaseRequest.description: "Advance to next phase" (FR-12). `reason` is recorded on the state transition.

AdvanceResultDto.description:
Result of "advance to next phase" (FR-12). When the approval mode requires a gate for the next phase (§4.2),
`gate` is the pending gate that was created and `state` still shows the current phase; otherwise
`gate` is `null` and `state` shows the new phase.

AgentModelsDto.description: Model id per agent; an omitted or `null` agent uses the default model.

AgentRunDetailDto.description:
An agent run with the provider's output text (FR-23). `output` is `null` until the run succeeds and is cut
to the first 200,000 characters (`outputTruncated`).

AgentRunDto.description:
An agent run (FR-23): which agent ran in which phase (and step), on which provider and model, with which prompt
template version and input artifact versions; its status, provider attempts (FR-25), token counts, estimated cost in
USD, duration and error. `userFeedback` is the feedback or answers given to the agent.

AgentRunStatus.description: Status of an agent run (FR-23, FR-25).

ApiTokenDto.description: A personal API token as listed (never includes the token or its hash).

ArtifactAuthorDto.description:
Who produced an artifact version (FR-16): a user (`user`, for drafts edited in the browser or uploaded via the
CLI) or an agent run (`agentRunId`). Exactly one of the two is set.

ArtifactDiffDto.description:
A line diff between versions `from` and `to` of one artifact type (FR-21): `unifiedDiff` is the
unified-diff text (3 lines of context) and `lines` the same hunks as context/added/removed lines, with each
unchanged run outside them collapsed into one `skipped` entry, for side-by-side rendering. Versions with more
than 100,000 lines together are not diffed (400 `VALIDATION`).

ArtifactDto.description:
One artifact version with its Markdown content (FR-16, §4.3). `contentHash` is the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the
normalised content; `integrity` is `corrupted` when it no longer matches (FR-20). `approvedBy` and
`approvedAt` are set once approved (status `locked`); `rejectionComment` once rejected (FR-17).

ArtifactIntegrity.description:
Result of re-checking an artifact's content hash on read (FR-20). `corrupted` means the stored content no
longer matches `content_hash` (§4.3), or the row is already marked ArtifactStatus.Corrupted.

ArtifactStateDto.description: Latest and current locked version of one artifact type (§6 project state).

ArtifactSummaryDto.description:
One artifact version without its content (FR-16, FR-21): the artifacts page cards and the history list.
`integrity` is the result of re-checking the content hash on this read (FR-20).

AuthProvidersDto.description: Which sign-in providers are available (the frontend hides GitHub when it isn't configured).

CategoryScoreDto.description:
One compliance category (§4.7): its weight, the agent's score (0–1), the deterministic penalty (sum of the fixed
critical/major/minor penalties of its deterministic violations) and the final score (agent score − penalty, floored
at 0), with the agent's evidence.

ComplianceDriftDto.description: The drift level and areas of the latest compliance report (FR-41, §4.7).

ComplianceReportDto.description:
The compliance report of one review cycle (FR-38, FR-41). `overallScore` is Σ category score × weight (3 dp);
`threshold` is the project's compliance threshold. `decision` follows §4.5; `decisionReason` is set
when the decision is `escalation_required` (`low_score`, `severe_drift`, `max_cycles`,
`no_improvement` or `no_optimization_plan` — another cycle was required but the review proposed no
optimisation steps), else `null`. `optimizationPlanArtifactId` is the optimisation plan draft the review
produced (FR-40), if any.

ComplianceTrendDto.description: The compliance score across review cycles, oldest first (FR-41), with the project's threshold. Empty before the first review.

ComplianceTrendPointDto.description:
One review cycle's result in the compliance trend (FR-41). `threshold` is the compliance threshold that cycle was
decided against (the report's snapshot; the project's threshold may have changed since).

expiresAt.description: Optional expiry; must be in the future.

baseVersion.description:
The version the edit started from. When set, the save is refused with 409 `CONFLICT` (details
`latestVersion: N`) unless it is still the latest version of the type, so a version saved meanwhile is
never silently superseded. Omit it to always save (CLI uploads).

CreateArtifactDraftRequest.description: A new draft version of an artifact type from edited Markdown (FR-18).

token.description: GitHub access token (`github` only). Stored encrypted and never returned.

CreateProjectGitRequest.description: Git step of the new-project wizard (FR-5, FR-35).

tokenBudget.description: Token budget (at least 1000); `null` or omitted means unlimited.

CreateProjectRequest.description: The new-project wizard (FR-5). Omitted settings take the FR-5 defaults.

CreatedApiTokenDto.description: A newly created token. string CreatedApiTokenDto.Token is shown once and can't be retrieved again.

DecideArtifactRequest.description: Approve or reject a draft (FR-17). On reject, `comment` is recorded and fed to the re-run agent.

DecideGateRequest.description:
Approve or reject a pending gate (FR-13, FR-14). `comment` is optional (on reject it is the feedback for the
re-run agent). Escalation gates are approved with a `decision`; `rollback` also needs a
`targetVersion`. Other gates take neither (400 `INVALID_DECISION`), and escalation gates can't be rejected.

DeclaredFileDto.description:
A file a step declares it creates or modifies (FR-29). `protected` marks a protected path (§4.6: .git/, .aide/, CI
workflows, lockfiles, .env files) — only an Owner-edited plan can declare one; the step may then write it.

DiffLineDto.description:
One line of a diff between two versions (FR-21). `oldLine` is the 1-based line number in the `from` version
(null for `added`), `newLine` the line number in the `to` version (null for `removed`); `text`
is the line without its line ending. Lines are in order, so a side-by-side view pairs them by line numbers.
A `skipped` entry stands for `skipped` unchanged lines (more than 3 lines from any change) that are left
out: `oldLine`/`newLine` are the numbers of the first of them and `text` is empty; `skipped` is
null for every other kind.

DiffLineKind.description: The kind of one line of a line diff between two artifact versions (FR-21).

DriftAreaDto.description: A drift area reported by the review agent (§4.7).

EvidenceDto.description: Why the review agent scored a category as it did: a file (when the evidence points at one) and the reason.

ExecutionCountsDto.description: Step counts of the current plan version.

ExecutionPlanDto.description: The plan version the steps belong to.

ExecutionRunStatus.description:
The execution runner's overall state for a project (FR-31, FR-33, FR-37): `idle` (not started, or nothing to run),
`running`, `paused` (no new step starts; a running step may still finish), `completed` (every step of the
current plan completed) or `blocked` (a step is blocked awaiting an escalation decision).

ExecutionStateDto.description:
The execution runner's state after a start/pause/resume request (FR-31, FR-37). `paused` is the project's pause flag;
`currentStepNumber` is the step `in_progress`, if any; `counts` are over the current plan version's steps.

ExecutionStepDto.description:
One execution step of a plan version (FR-30–FR-34): the plan step (number, title, task, declared files, dependencies on
earlier step numbers, user instructions) and its progress — status, attempt, the last attempt's violations, and the
branch and commit once accepted. `commitUrl` links the commit on GitHub; it is `null` for the Local provider
(no remote) and before the step is committed.

ExecutionStepsDto.description: A plan version's execution steps in step order (FR-30); `plan` is `null` (and no steps) before any plan is approved.

FileAction.description: Declared action for a file in a plan step (FR-29).

FileManifestEntryDto.description: A file an accepted step wrote (FR-34), with the SHA-256 of its content.

FindingSource.description: Where a review violation came from (§4.7): a deterministic check or the Code Review agent.

GateDto.description:
An approval gate (§4.2, FR-12–FR-15). `artifactId`, `artifactType` and `artifactVersion` identify
the gated artifact (spec and plan gates). Escalation gates carry `escalationReason` and, once decided,
`decision` (and `targetVersion` for a rollback). `reason` is a human-readable context line.
`decidedBy`, `decidedAt` and `comment` are set once the gate is decided. `overdue` is true
72 hours after creation while pending (FR-15). An escalation raised by a blocked execution step (FR-33) has
`escalationReason` `step_blocked` and names the step in `executionStepId` and `stepNumber`
(both `null` otherwise).

GitProvider.description: Git provider of a project (FR-35). Wire values: `github`, `local`.

GitSettingsDto.description: Git settings (FR-9, FR-35). The token is never returned, only `hasToken`. `branchName` is the project branch, once the working copy has been prepared.

GitTestResultDto.description: Result of testing the saved Git settings (FR-10); `reason` says why when `ok` is false.

errorCode.description: Stable UPPER_SNAKE error code from the spec's error table (SPEC §6).

traceId.description: Trace id for correlating the error with server logs.

details.description: Individual reasons, when there are several.

LlmProviderStatusDto.description: Whether a provider can be used: a system key is configured or the project has its own key (Ollama and Fake are always configured).

LlmSettingsDto.description: LLM settings (FR-9, FR-22). The API key is never returned, only `hasApiKey`. `providers` lists every provider with whether it's usable and its system default model.

NotificationChannelDto.description:
A notification channel (FR-47). Secrets are never returned, only `hasSecret`. For `email` and
`webhook`, `target` is the saved address or URL and the secret is a webhook's HMAC signing key. For
`slack` and `teams`, the incoming-webhook URL is itself the secret (a bearer credential): it is stored
encrypted, `target` is only a masked display value (host only, e.g. `hooks.slack.com/…`) and
`hasSecret` is `true` once a URL is saved.

id.description: The id of an existing channel to keep (its secret, or Slack/Teams URL, is kept unless a new one or `clearSecret` is sent, or the type changes); omit for a new channel.

target.description:
Email address (email) or https URL (webhook); required for both. For slack and teams the URL is sent in
`secret` and `target` may be omitted or echo the masked value; an absolute URL sent here is still
accepted as the incoming-webhook URL (older clients) and treated as a secret.

secret.description:
The channel secret, stored encrypted and never returned: the HMAC signing key (webhook) or the https
incoming-webhook URL (slack, teams; required for a new channel). Email channels have none.

NotificationChannelInput.description: A channel in a notification settings update.

NotificationEvent.description: Events a notification channel can subscribe to (FR-47). Wire values are snake_case.

PagedResultOfAdminUserDto.description: One page of results. int PagedResult<T>.Page is 1-based.

PagedResultOfAgentRunDto.description: One page of results. int PagedResult<T>.Page is 1-based.

PagedResultOfProjectSummaryDto.description: One page of results. int PagedResult<T>.Page is 1-based.

Phase.description: The six lifecycle phases, in order (§4.1). Stored as snake_case strings.

errorCode.description: Stable UPPER_SNAKE error code from the spec's error table (SPEC §6).

traceId.description: Trace id for correlating the error with server logs.

details.description: Individual reasons, when there are several.

ProjectDto.description: A project as shown on its overview and settings pages (FR-5, FR-7). `myRole` is the caller's project role (`null` for an Admin who isn't a member); a `null` `tokenBudget` means unlimited.

category.description: Categories of project events, used to filter the activity feed (FR-50) and to group live updates (FR-46).

ProjectEventMessage.description:
A project event pushed live to everyone viewing the project (FR-46): the SignalR `projectEvent` message.
`id`, `type`, `payload` and `createdAt` are the stored audit event (FR-50); `category` tells the
page which data to refresh. Not an HTTP response: the schema is added to the OpenAPI components by
LiveContractDocumentTransformer so the generated client has the type.

ProjectSettingsDto.description: All project settings with secrets as set / not set flags (FR-9).

ProjectStateDto.description: Deterministic project state for the overview page and the CLI (§6 `/api/projects/:id/state`). `tokensUsed` counts every agent run's tokens; a `null` `tokenBudget` means unlimited (FR-26). `executionStatus` is the execution runner's state over the current plan (FR-31, FR-37). `pullRequest` is the project PR once AIDE has opened it (FR-36), else `null`. `latestRelease` is the latest release attempt (FR-42, FR-43), else `null`.

ProjectStatus.description: Project status (§4.1: status follows phase; `released` and `rolled_back` are special).

ProjectSummaryDto.description: A row of the projects list (FR-6). `myRole` is `null` for an Admin who isn't a member.

ProjectVersionDto.description:
A project version from the state transitions (FR-44), for the rollback target picker: the phase entered at that version
and when. `rollbackAllowed` says whether it is a valid rollback target now; when it isn't,
`rollbackBlockedReason` says why (`current_version`, `release_phase`). Rate limits and running work
(RATE_LIMITED, ROLLBACK_BLOCKED) are not reflected here: they are checked when the rollback is requested.

PullRequestCommitDto.description: A commit on the project branch that isn't on the default branch; `url` links it on GitHub (`null` for Local).

PullRequestDto.description:
The project PR with its branch comparison (FR-35, FR-36), read live from the working copy: the commits (newest first, at
most 250) and changed files (at most 1000; `truncated` when either list was cut). `comparisonAvailable` is
`false` when the working copy or a branch is missing (then both lists are empty).

PullRequestFileDto.description: A file changed on the project branch since it left the default branch.

PullRequestFileStatus.description: How a file differs between the default branch and the project branch (lowercase on the wire, like every enum).

PullRequestSummaryDto.description:
The project PR once recorded (FR-36): provider, base (default) and head (project) branch, and for GitHub its number and
web URL (both `null` for Local, whose "PR" is the recorded branch comparison). `openedAt` is when AIDE last
opened or reused it.

RefinementAnswerDto.description: An answer given to the agent: `questionId` when it answered a question of a round, and the question text.

RefinementAnswerRequest.description:
An answer for the next refinement round (FR-27): `questionId` of a question from the latest round, or the
`question` text for anything else, and the `answer`.

RefinementDto.description:
The refinement page (FR-27): the latest project request version (`latestDraft`, without content — read it from
the artifacts API), the latest round and its status, and the clarifying questions of the latest completed round
(`questionsRunId`) with any answers already given.

RefinementQuestionDto.description:
A clarifying question of the latest completed round (FR-27). `answer` is the answer already given for the next
round (while that round is queued or running, or after it failed), else `null`.

RefinementRoundDto.description:
One refinement round (FR-27): an idea refinement job and its agent run. `runId` is the run that produced (or will
produce) the draft — the corrective re-run when the first reply couldn't be read; the run appears under
`/runs/{runId}` once the job has started. `status` is `queued` until then. `trigger` says who started
it: a writer (`user_requested`), or a rejected or corrupted project request. A round that ended without a draft
because the project no longer allowed one (e.g. a release in progress) is `cancelled`, with the reason in `error`. `answers` and `feedback` are
what the agent was given; `draftArtifactId`/`draftVersion` the project request version it created.

password.description: At least 8 characters with a letter and a digit.

ReleaseDto.description:
A release attempt (FR-42, FR-43). `status` is `in_progress` while the release job is queued or running, then
`succeeded` (merged into the default branch and tagged `tag`, `mergeCommitSha` set) or `failed`.
A failed release carries `errorCode` (e.g. `MERGE_CONFLICT`) and `errorMessage`; on a merge conflict
`conflictingFiles` lists the files (empty otherwise). `pullRequestUrl` is the merged GitHub PR (`null`
for Local). `attempt` counts the release attempts for this project version (1 for the first, +1 per retry).
`completedAt` is `null` while in progress. `tag` is `v<version>-aide` until the release succeeds,
then the tag it was recorded with: `v<version>-aide.<k>` when the version number was reused after a rollback
and the base tag holds an earlier release; several attempts of one version may succeed (re-releases after rollbacks).
`mergeCommitSha` is set as soon as the merge exists, before tagging.

ReleaseStatus.description: Outcome of a release attempt (FR-42, FR-43).

ReleaseSummaryDto.description: The latest release attempt in the project state (FR-42, FR-43): enough for the overview's release banner.

ReviewRunStatus.description: The review job's state for the project (FR-38): no review in the current cycle, queued or running, finished, or failed.

ReviewStartedDto.description: A review was queued (FR-38): the review job's id and the cycle number the review will record.

ReviewStateDto.description: Review cycle progress and the latest compliance result (FR-38). `maxCycles` includes extra cycles granted by escalations (FR-14 continue). `status` is the review job's state: `running` while a review is queued or running, then `completed` or `failed`; `idle` before the first cycle or after a rollback cleared the review state (§4.8).

RollbackDto.description:
A recorded rollback (FR-44, §4.8): from `fromVersion` to `toVersion`, restoring `restoredPhase`.
`invalidatedArtifactIds` are the artifacts created after the target version; `resetStepIds` the steps of
invalidated plans (now `invalidated`); `requeuedStepIds` the blocked or rejected steps of surviving plans
(back to `pending`); `cancelledGateIds` and `cancelledJobIds` the pending gates and queued jobs it
cancelled. `createdBy` is the Owner (or the system, for an escalation decision recorded by a worker).

RollbackRequest.description:
Roll the project back to an earlier project version (FR-44, §4.8). `targetVersion` must be below the current
version, recorded, and not a release-phase version; `reason` is recorded on the rollback and its state transition.

RunInputArtifactDto.description: An artifact version a run used as input (FR-23).

Severity.description: Severity of a review finding or drift area (§4.7).

StartRefinementRequest.description: Start a refinement round (FR-27), optionally answering some or all clarifying questions of the latest round.

StepViolationDto.description: A Guardian violation recorded on a step's last rejected attempt (§4.6, FR-32). Never contains secret values.

repoUrl.description: Required when the provider is (or becomes) `github`.

token.description: Sets the access token. To remove it, send `clearToken: true`.

UpdateGitSettingsRequest.description: Partial update of the Git settings. Omitted fields are unchanged.

apiKey.description: Sets the project's own API key. To remove it, send `clearApiKey: true`.

UpdateLlmSettingsRequest.description: Partial update of the LLM settings. Omitted fields are unchanged; `modelsByAgent`, when sent, replaces the map.

tokenBudget.description: Sets the token budget (at least 1000). To remove the budget, send `clearTokenBudget: true`.

clearTokenBudget.description: `true` removes the token budget (unlimited). Can't be combined with `tokenBudget`.

UpdateProjectRequest.description: Partial update of a project (FR-7). Omitted fields are unchanged.

UserDto.description: The signed-in user (or a user, for admins).

ViolationDto.description: A violation found by a deterministic check or the review agent (§4.7). `file` and `evidence` are set when known.
